question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes. We ship to India, the US, the UK, Germany, Japan, Brazil, the UAE and Canada.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free for orders above 50 USD. Below that, standard shipping costs 4.99 USD.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Yes, while the order status is PENDING or PAID. After it is SHIPPED the address cannot be changed.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original box.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Open My Orders, choose the order, click Return Item and print the free return label.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Opened beauty products, grocery items and gift cards cannot be returned.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open My Orders and click Track. You will also get an email with the tracking link when the order ships.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel an order while it is PENDING or PAID. Shipped orders must be returned instead.

question: Why was my order cancelled?
answer: Orders are cancelled if payment fails or an item goes out of stock. You are never charged for cancelled orders.

question: What do the order statuses mean?
answer: PENDING means we are waiting for payment, PAID means payment is done, SHIPPED means it is on the way, CANCELLED means it was stopped.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI and PayPal.

question: Is my payment information safe?
answer: Yes. Card details are handled by our payment provider and never stored on our servers.

question: Why was I charged twice?
answer: You were not. A temporary hold may appear, but it disappears within 3 business days. Contact support if it does not.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the link we email you. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings, then Privacy, then Delete Account. Your data is removed within 30 days.

question: Can I change my email address?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings, then Profile. We will send a confirmation link to the new address.

question: Are your electronics covered by warranty?
answer: Yes. All electronics have a 1 year manufacturer warranty.

question: How do I know if an item is in stock?
answer: The product page shows In Stock, Low Stock (less than 10 left) or Out of Stock.

question: Will out of stock items come back?
answer: Most items are restocked within 2 weeks. Click Notify Me on the product page to get an email.

question: How do I contact a human?
answer: Type 'talk to a human' in the chat or email support@shopsphere.example. We reply within 24 hours.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: The chatbot is available 24/7. Human support works Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.

question: Can businesses buy in bulk?
answer: Yes. Orders above 100 units get a 10 percent discount. Contact sales@shopsphere.example.
